newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran cuts March crude prices 10-15 cts/bbl-traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran cuts March crude prices 10-15 cts/bbl-traders.

text.p: State-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) has cut its crude pricing formula for Iranian Light and Iranian Heavy crude for March loading by 15 and 10 cents a barrel respectively, traders in Tokyo said on Friday.
Following the cut, Iranian Light for March loading will be priced at Oman's MPM minus seven cents, with an automatic adjustment factor added to that.
Iranian Heavy will be priced at Dubai quotations minus 13 cents, with an automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.
The price of Iranian Heavy crude is linked to Saudi Arabia's Arab Medium, while Iranian Light is linked to Arab Light prices.
Iranian crude prices are set on a quarterly basis. However, under a contract agreement, NIOC and customers can review prices whenever Saudi Arabian crude prices move substantially.
